title: Who will walk with you?
description: Jesus met people one by one, then gathered them. Share what God is doing, carry one another in prayer, and find a group to walk with.

status.signIn: Sign in to share on the board, pray with others and join groups. The people you add under My people work without signing in.
status.profile: Choose your name and handle to join the community.
status.offline: You’re offline. The board needs a connection; My people still works.

post.deleteDescription: It disappears from the board and any prayer links stop working. Your private stone stays in your journal.
post.reported: Thank you. We’ll review this post.

comments.empty: No comments yet. Offer a word of encouragement.

search.none: No one found with that handle.

groups.none: You haven’t joined a group yet.
groups.discoverHint: Anyone on Ebenezer can join an open group. Private groups are invite-only.
groups.noneOpen: No open groups to join right now. Start one!
groups.leaveDescription: You’ll stop seeing this group’s posts. A leader can invite you back.
groups.deleteDescription: This removes the group and everything shared in it for every member. This can’t be undone.

form.intro: Gather the people you already walk with, or open a group for anyone who needs it.
form.name: Group name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: For example, friends who studied abroad and are settling back home

people.knownHint: Family and friends without an account. They stay on this device and receive requests through your own messaging app.
people.noContacts: No one yet. Add someone like Mom or a mentor.
people.friendsHint: People who accepted your friend request. They can receive requests inside Ebenezer.
people.noFriends: No friends yet. Find someone by their handle.
people.signInForFriends: Sign in to add friends who use Ebenezer.
people.removeContactDescription: They’ll be removed from this device. Nothing is sent to them.
people.removeFriendDescription: Anything you shared only with each other will no longer be visible to the other person.
people.linkDescription: When you ask someone without Ebenezer to pray, you can include a private prayer link. It opens only that request, never your journal, and expires after 14 days.

form.intro: Add someone you’d like beside you in prayer. Adding them never sends a message, and their details stay on this device.
form.name: What do you call them?
form.namePlaceholder: For example, Mom or Pastor Mark
form.channel: How would you like to reach them?
form.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +86 138 0000 0000.

ask.title: Ask {{name}} to pray
ask.description: Edit the message, then send it your way. You stay in control of who receives it.
ask.defaultMessage: Hi {{name}}, would you pray for me this week? I’m holding on to God’s help and would love you beside me in prayer.
ask.link: Include a private prayer link for {{name}}
ask.linkHint: {{name}} can open it without an account and tell you they prayed.
ask.linkUnavailable: Sign in to include a private prayer link. You can still send the message without one.
ask.linkReady: Link ready. It’s added to your message and expires in 14 days. Untick to withdraw it.
ask.linkLine: Tap to let me know you prayed:
ask.sentInApp: Your prayer request was sent to {{name}}.
ask.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the message and copy it yourself.
ask.privacy: Ebenezer never sends outside messages for you. Opening an app doesn’t mean the message was sent.

pray.title: {{name}} asked you to pray
pray.thanks: Thank you. {{name}} will see that you prayed.
pray.privacy: Only this request is shared with you. No account is needed, and the link expires.
pray.missingHint: It may have expired or been withdrawn. You can still ask the person who sent it.
pray.retryHint: Check your connection and try opening this prayer request again.
